entries.name: arrayToEnum
entries.decision: Merge into a future safe `keyBy`/lookup builder only if consumers need it.
entries.behavior: Freezes an object mapping each array value to itself; property coercion and unsafe keys are unspecified.

entries.name: isOneOf
entries.decision: Native `Array.prototype.includes`.
entries.behavior: Strict membership in an array.

entries.name: uniqueArray
entries.decision: Adopted as `array.unique`.
entries.behavior: Set-based first-occurrence deduplication after legacy array validation.

entries.name: mergeArray
entries.decision: Native spread/`concat`; merge deduplicated behavior into future `union`.
entries.behavior: Concatenates two arrays and optionally deduplicates via a positional boolean.

entries.name: replaceIfInvalid
entries.decision: Adopted `validation.defaultIfBlank`; all whitespace-only strings now select the fallback.
entries.behavior: Replaces null, undefined, empty string, or exactly one space.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x validation tests.

entries.name: removeEmpty
entries.decision: Merge as an explicit predicate/filter recipe; `compact` remains nullish-only.
entries.behavior: Removes null, undefined, and empty strings while retaining `0` and `false`.

entries.name: parseTextToArray
entries.decision: Merge into a future `splitMany` with escaped alternation or deterministic scanning.
entries.behavior: Splits by one or multiple literal delimiters using a collision-prone sentinel.
entries.evidence: Source reviewed; sentinel can corrupt input.

entries.name: cleanJSON
entries.decision: Reject the misleading name; related explicit replacement is `data.initializeLike(value, { arrays: "sample" })`.
entries.behavior: Recursively replaces scalar values with type defaults and keeps only the first array element.
entries.evidence: Defect/behavior proven from source; 2.x initialization tests.

entries.name: sanitizeObj
entries.decision: Reject.
entries.behavior: Mutates recursively, calls an undefined `cleanInvalid`, and returns `forEach`'s `undefined`.

entries.name: sanitizeObjArray
entries.decision: Reject.
entries.behavior: Maps through broken `sanitizeObj`, producing undefined entries.

entries.name: formatObjArray
entries.decision: App-local formatting or redesign as a mapper supplied by the caller.
entries.behavior: Mutates object entries and assumes every nested value has string methods.

entries.name: cleanArray
entries.decision: Native `array.filter(Boolean)`; do not conflate with nullish `compact`.
entries.behavior: Removes every falsy value.

entries.name: removeKey
entries.decision: Adopted as `object.omit` for one or many keys.
entries.behavior: Returns a shallow copy with one own key deleted.

entries.name: findOne
entries.decision: Merge into separate `findBy`, text predicate, and property access operations; reject shape-changing return.
entries.behavior: Finds by property with optional case/substring matching, then returns either a property or the object.

entries.name: findAll
entries.decision: Native `filter` plus `map`, or future `findAllBy` if usage supports it.
entries.behavior: Filters by one exact property and optionally plucks another property.

entries.name: objectFindByKey
entries.decision: Native `find`; reject sentinel return shape.
entries.behavior: Linear property lookup returning either an object or `{ error: "Not found" }`.

entries.name: splice
entries.decision: Reject; use immutable `map` plus object spread.
entries.behavior: Mutates every object in an array with `Object.assign`; name conflicts with array splice.

entries.name: flatten
entries.decision: Adopted strict `array.flatten`, delegating to native `flat` with documented depth and sparse-slot behavior.
entries.behavior: This-bound recursive array flattening that calls nonexistent `this.flatten` in normal module use.

entries.name: flattenObj
entries.decision: Defer a safe path-aware record flattener.
entries.behavior: Mutates nullish values in the input and joins nested keys with underscores without collision protection.

entries.name: flattenObjArray
entries.decision: Merge only after a canonical record-flatten contract exists.
entries.behavior: Applies `flattenObj` with inconsistent nesting and return shapes.

entries.name: flatMapObjText
entries.decision: App-local presentation.
entries.behavior: Recursively concatenates object labels and values for display without separators.

entries.name: validateObject
entries.decision: Reject implementation; use `keys.every(key => Object.hasOwn(value, key))` or future `hasOwnKeys`.
entries.behavior: Intended to require keys, but `return false` inside `forEach` does not escape; most nonempty key lists pass.

entries.name: validateObjectArray
entries.decision: Reject implementation; reconsider as `filter` plus `hasOwnKeys`.
entries.behavior: Filters objects through broken `validateObject`.

entries.name: hasKeys
entries.decision: Reject; split predicate and filter behaviors.
entries.behavior: Named as a predicate but filters arrays and repeats ineffective `forEach` returns.

entries.name: extractKey
entries.decision: Native `map`; possible documented `pluck` only if frequent use warrants it.
entries.behavior: Maps one property from each object.

entries.name: extractKeyArray
entries.decision: Merge with `extractKey`; prefer native `map`.
entries.behavior: Duplicate property projection with additional legacy validation.

entries.name: extractKeys
entries.decision: Compose `map` with adopted `object.pick`.
entries.behavior: Maps each object to a selected-key object.

entries.name: getObjKeys
entries.decision: App-local UI adapter.
entries.behavior: Converts object keys into `{ key, value }` selector records.

entries.name: objValsToArray
entries.decision: Native `Object.values`.
entries.behavior: Returns enumerable own property values.

entries.name: arrayToObjArray
entries.decision: Native `map`; unsafe property names would need protection in a wrapper.
entries.behavior: Wraps every array value under a caller-provided property name.

entries.name: keySortData
entries.decision: Adopted/generalized as `sort.sortBy`.
entries.behavior: Returns a copied array sorted by a property and direction.

entries.name: filterKeys
entries.decision: Adopted as `object.pick`.
entries.behavior: Builds an object from selected input keys.

entries.name: filterData
entries.decision: Defer or keep app-local until real query semantics are captured.
entries.behavior: Applies a custom array-of-filter-records query language with coercion and substring policy.

entries.name: filterDataFast
entries.decision: Reject as a duplicate implementation; disposition behavior-by-behavior with `filterData`.
entries.behavior: Alternate filter engine with JSON stringification and different matching behavior.

entries.name: has
entries.decision: Use `hasAtPath` for known paths or `findDeep` for bounded recursive key discovery.
entries.behavior: Recursively checks for a key, mixing arrays/objects and legacy validity rules.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x path/traversal tests.

entries.name: hasAll
entries.decision: Reject implementation; compose the intended every-key policy explicitly with bounded `findDeep` calls.
entries.behavior: Attempts recursive presence of all keys, with loop-return control-flow defects.
entries.evidence: Defect proven; current consumer audit and 2.x traversal tests.

entries.name: valContains
entries.decision: Adopted for actual strings as `string.includesText`; non-string search requires a separate explicit serializer/search API.
entries.behavior: JSON-stringifies values before substring comparison.

entries.name: objContains
entries.decision: Merge into canonical traversal/search.
entries.behavior: Recursively searches object values but relies on returns inside `forEach`.

entries.name: arrayContains
entries.decision: Merge into canonical traversal/search; primitive membership uses native `includes`.
entries.behavior: Recursively searches array values with inconsistent object handling.

entries.name: deepGetKey
entries.decision: Compose `object.findDeep(value, ({ key }) => key === target)?.value`; missing results now use undefined.
entries.behavior: Recursively returns values associated with a matching key.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x bounded traversal tests.

entries.name: deepSearch
entries.decision: Compose `object.findDeep` and select its value or parent from the path-aware result.
entries.behavior: Recursively searches a named key using a predicate and optionally returns a parent.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x bounded traversal tests.

entries.name: deepSearchItems
entries.decision: Reject implementation; merge behavior into canonical traversal.
entries.behavior: Deep search variant that calls `this.deepSearchItems`, making module invocation fragile.

entries.name: deepFindSet
entries.decision: Reject; use `setAtPath` for known paths and design predicate-based deep update separately.
entries.behavior: Intended immutable deep update, but recursive `forEach` returns are discarded; generally only a root match survives.

entries.name: cloneObj
entries.decision: Adopted replacement `object.deepClone` using `structuredClone`.
entries.behavior: Recursive enumerable string-key clone that loses prototypes and special built-ins.

entries.name: deepCopy
entries.decision: Adopted replacement `object.deepClone`.
entries.behavior: Recursive `for...in` clone without cycles or built-in preservation.

entries.name: deepCopyJSON
entries.decision: Adopted replacement `object.deepClone`; keep JSON round-trip only as explicit serialization.
entries.behavior: JSON round-trip clone loses unsupported values/types and fails on cycles.

entries.name: findAndSetObject
entries.decision: Defer a cycle-safe predicate update API; known paths use `setAtPath`.
entries.behavior: Mutates every recursively found property with a matching key.

entries.name: sortObject
entries.decision: Native `Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).sort(...))`; adopt only if consumer evidence warrants.
entries.behavior: Creates a new object with enumerable string keys in lexical order.

entries.name: sortObjArray
entries.decision: Adopted immutable replacements `sortBy`/`sortByNumericOrder`.
entries.behavior: Mutates input using numeric subtraction on a property.

entries.name: valid
entries.decision: Reject; adopted literal predicate `validation.isDefined`.
entries.behavior: References undeclared `variable` instead of `value`, throwing for defined input.

entries.name: isValid
entries.decision: Reject umbrella predicate; use `isDefined`, `isBlank`, `isEmpty`, or a domain validator.
entries.behavior: Changes meaning by type and optional positional boolean; treats several legitimate falsy values as invalid.

entries.name: validate
entries.decision: Reject; compose explicit predicates with `every`.
entries.behavior: Attempts nested truthiness checks, but returns inside `forEach` do not affect the result.

entries.name: cleanInvalid
entries.decision: Adopted `validation.defaultIfBlank`; all whitespace-only strings now select the fallback.
entries.behavior: Duplicate fallback logic for nullish, empty string, and one space.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x validation tests.

entries.name: isDefined
entries.decision: Adopted as `validation.isDefined`.
entries.behavior: Checks non-nullish values.

entries.name: isTruthy
entries.decision: Reject misleading name; use native Boolean, a literal check, or `!validation.isBlank` when whitespace is absent.
entries.behavior: Means defined and not empty string rather than JavaScript truthiness.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x validation tests.

entries.name: isString
entries.decision: Adopted primitive-only `validation.isString`; boxed String objects no longer pass.
entries.behavior: Cross-realm string tag check.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x validation tests.

entries.name: isNumber
entries.decision: Adopted primitive `validation.isNumber`; use `validation.isFiniteNumber` when arithmetic requires a finite value.
entries.behavior: Checks `typeof value === "number"`, including `NaN` and infinities.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x type-guard tests.

entries.name: isNum
entries.decision: Reject duplicate legacy spelling; migrate to `validation.isNumber`.
entries.behavior: Exact duplicate of `isNumber`.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x type-guard tests.

entries.name: isInt
entries.decision: Native `Number.isInteger`; possible canonical type guard.
entries.behavior: Integer check via modulo.

entries.name: isSafeInt
entries.decision: Adopted as explicit `validation.isSafeInteger`; native `Number.isSafeInteger` remains equally valid inline.
entries.behavior: Safe integer check with redundant number test.

entries.name: isFloat
entries.decision: Adopted explicit `validation.isFiniteNonInteger`; non-finite values no longer pass.
entries.behavior: Defines float as any number that is not an integer, including problematic values.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x type-guard tests.

entries.name: isBool
entries.decision: Adopted clearly named primitive `validation.isBoolean`.
entries.behavior: Checks exact true or false.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x type-guard tests.

entries.name: isBlank
entries.decision: Adopted replacement `validation.isBlank` with literal nullish/whitespace semantics.
entries.behavior: References `this.length`/`this.trim()` in an arrow function and can throw.

entries.name: escapeHtml
entries.decision: Adopted under `string.escapeHtml`, documented as escaping rather than sanitization.
entries.behavior: Escapes five text-significant HTML characters.

entries.name: isJSONRegex
entries.decision: Reject.
entries.behavior: This-bound prototype-style function calls nonexistent `blank()` and uses a regex approximation.

entries.name: isJSON
entries.decision: Adopted replacement `validation.isJson`, accepting all valid JSON text.
entries.behavior: Parses undeclared `str` instead of the argument and rejects valid scalar intent ambiguously.

entries.name: isMap
entries.decision: Adopted as `validation.isMap` with a cross-realm brand check.
entries.behavior: `instanceof Map` predicate.

entries.name: isSet
entries.decision: Adopted as `validation.isSet` with a cross-realm brand check.
entries.behavior: `instanceof Set` predicate.

entries.name: isFile
entries.decision: Adopted as `validation.isFile` using safe `globalThis.File` detection.
entries.behavior: Uses `'File' in window` and direct `File`, throwing outside browsers.

entries.name: isBlob
entries.decision: Adopted as `validation.isBlob` using safe `globalThis.Blob` detection.
entries.behavior: Uses `'Blob' in window` and direct `Blob`, throwing outside browsers.

entries.name: isObject
entries.decision: Adopted exact-shape `validation.isNonArrayObject`; use `object.isPlainObject` when prototypes matter.
entries.behavior: Any defined non-array object, including Dates, Maps, and class instances.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x validation/plain-object tests.

entries.name: isArray
entries.decision: Adopted discoverable `validation.isArray`; native `Array.isArray` remains equally valid inline.
entries.behavior: Null-safe array predicate.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x cross-realm tests.

entries.name: isValidArray
entries.decision: Adopted clear predicate `array.isNonEmptyArray`; use `Array.isArray` when emptiness is allowed.
entries.behavior: Rejects empty arrays and arrays whose first item is undefined even when length checking is disabled.

entries.name: arrayContainsObjects
entries.decision: Merge into explicit `some(isPlainObject)` or `every(isPlainObject)` recipes.
entries.behavior: Returns true for any `typeof "object"` item, including null and arrays.

entries.name: isObjectArray
entries.decision: Reject ambiguous semantics; adopted `validation.isPlainObjectArray`, which requires every item to be a plain object and explicitly accepts an empty array.
entries.behavior: Means an array containing at least one object-like item, not an array entirely of objects.

entries.name: isAO
entries.decision: Reject abbreviation; compose `validation.isArray` and `validation.isNonArrayObject` explicitly.
entries.behavior: Uses `instanceof Array/Object`, with cross-realm and semantic ambiguity.
entries.evidence: Current consumer audit and 2.x cross-realm tests.

entries.name: getType
entries.decision: Split into atomic `validation.typeOf`, `data.normalizeDataType`, and full-slot `data.analyzeArrayTypes`.
entries.behavior: Returns custom strings and infers array type from only the first element.

entries.name: getFieldType
entries.decision: Split into `input.inputTypeForValue` and full-array `input.controlTypeForValue`; component/layout/schema policy stays app-local.
entries.behavior: Maps runtime values to HTML/form control concepts.
entries.evidence: Active-call-site regression review and 2.x input tests.

entries.name: getArrayType
entries.decision: Adopted structured replacement `data.analyzeArrayTypes`.
entries.behavior: Walks array elements to report a custom homogeneous/mixed type string.
entries.evidence: Full-slot, sparse, heterogeneous, and frozen-result tests.

entries.name: convertDate
entries.decision: Merge into adopted `date.formatDate` with explicit `Intl` options.
entries.behavior: Hard-coded English abbreviated weekday and full month display.
entries.evidence: 2.x date formatting tested at API level.

entries.name: sec2str
entries.decision: Defer a duration formatter with a stable grammar.
entries.behavior: Formats seconds with inconsistent omitted units and mixed suffix/colon output.

entries.name: elapsed
entries.decision: Merge into a named duration/difference helper with unit-explicit inputs.
entries.behavior: Returns `(finish - start) / 1000`, despite docs calling inputs seconds.

entries.name: timeElapsed
entries.decision: Reject implementation; future composition of elapsed duration and formatter.
entries.behavior: References undeclared `finishg`.

entries.name: estimate
entries.decision: Reject signature; design `estimateRemaining` explicitly.
entries.behavior: Documentation promises seconds but implementation returns `sec2str` and estimates total duration rather than remaining duration.

entries.name: timeEstimate
entries.decision: Reject.
entries.behavior: Omits `return` and passes the already formatted estimate back to `sec2str`.

entries.name: dateStr2LocaleDateStr
entries.decision: App-local portfolio/resume presentation or redesign as explicit parser.
entries.behavior: Parses English `Month Year`/`Present` and returns a locale-formatted string despite the name implying a Date.

entries.name: generateDateOptions
entries.decision: App-local UI adapter.
entries.behavior: Produces reverse chronological `{ key, value }` records for an HTML selector.

entries.name: convertTimestampToYYYYMMDDDD
entries.decision: Merge into adopted `date.localDateKey`.
entries.behavior: Produces unpadded local `YYYY-M-D`; name contains duplicated `DD`.

entries.name: convertYYYYMMDDDDtoTimestamp
entries.decision: Reject; use explicit local-date parsing when designed.
entries.behavior: Calls `new Date(date.split("-"))`, relying on array string coercion and host parsing.

entries.name: formatDate
entries.decision: Adopted stricter `date.formatDate`.
entries.behavior: Locale date formatting with a null fallback.

entries.name: formatDateDMY
entries.decision: Merge as a documented formatter preset rather than duplicate implementation.
entries.behavior: Formats a Date as local `DD/MM/YYYY`.

entries.name: formatDateDDMMYYYY
entries.decision: Reject duplicate; same future preset.
entries.behavior: Duplicate `formatDateDMY`.

entries.name: formatTimestampDDMMYYYY
entries.decision: Reject misleading alias; adopted `localDateKey` covers actual output.
entries.behavior: Name/docs say DD/MM/YYYY, implementation returns local `YYYY-MM-DD`.

entries.name: toCapitalCase
entries.decision: Adopted Unicode-aware `string.capitalize`.
entries.behavior: Uppercases the first UTF-16 code unit.

entries.name: toKebabCase
entries.decision: Adopted generalized `string.kebabCase`.
entries.behavior: Inserts a hyphen before every uppercase letter; does not normalize spaces/acronyms.

entries.name: toUpperCamelCase
entries.decision: Adopted generalized `string.pascalCase`.
entries.behavior: Converts hyphenated lowercase segments only.

entries.name: subStringSearch
entries.decision: Adopted `string.includesText` with a named option.
entries.behavior: Literal substring search with optional case sensitivity.

entries.name: replaceMultiple
entries.decision: Adopted safe literal `string.replaceMany`; explicit regex behavior uses `string.replaceRegex` with a cloned caller RegExp.
entries.behavior: Treats replacement keys as raw regular expressions.

entries.name: getLongest
entries.decision: Adopted `string.longestStringLength`.
entries.behavior: Returns maximum string length across array values, object keys, or a scalar.
entries.evidence: Function implemented; focused test expansion pending.

entries.name: clamp
entries.decision: Adopted strict `number.clamp`.
entries.behavior: Clamps without validating finite values or bound order.

entries.name: wrap
entries.decision: Adopted strict `number.wrap`.
entries.behavior: Modulo wrap over a half-open range.

entries.name: round
entries.decision: Adopted as `number.roundTo` with precision bounds.
entries.behavior: Decimal exponent-string rounding.

entries.name: add
entries.decision: Adopted strict `number.sum`.
entries.behavior: Sums values from zero without validation.

entries.name: sub
entries.decision: Reject as a likely defect; canonical `number.subtract(first, ...rest)` is explicit.
entries.behavior: Negates the sum of all inputs rather than subtracting subsequent inputs from the first.

entries.name: distance
entries.decision: Adopted strict `number.distance`.
entries.behavior: Absolute distance between two numbers.

entries.name: distance2
entries.decision: Merge object-coordinate compatibility into or alongside adopted tuple-based `distance2d` only if consumers require it.
entries.behavior: Euclidean distance between `{ x, y }` objects.

entries.name: boolRand
entries.decision: Split into adopted `randomBoolean` and future explicit `randomSign`.
entries.behavior: Documentation promises boolean, implementation returns `1` or `-1`.

entries.name: decToBinary
entries.decision: Adopted `number.toBinary`, returning a string.
entries.behavior: Recursive numeric-digit representation with bitwise truncation limits.

entries.name: rand
entries.decision: Adopted `random.randomFloat(minimum, maximum, random)`, with a breaking argument-order correction.
entries.behavior: Random float with unusual `(max, min)` parameter order.

entries.name: randString
entries.decision: Adopted `random.randomString` with security warning and injectable source.
entries.behavior: Random string from a character set; JSDoc was copied from integer random behavior.

entries.name: handleBasicFetch
entries.decision: Reject implementation; adopted `http.request` checks status and exposes explicit parsing.
entries.behavior: Redundant Promise wrapper, always parses JSON, and never checks `response.ok`.

entries.name: fetchData
entries.decision: Reject; compose adopted `http.request` with an application callback only where needed.
entries.behavior: Callback API, sends JSON bodies for GET, logs/swallow errors, and returns no request promise.
entries.evidence: Source reviewed; error swallowing proven; 2.x HTTP tests.

entries.name: constructFetchError
entries.decision: Replace with a typed `HttpError` data contract.
entries.behavior: Returns a record containing methods and a live response, making serialization incomplete and unstable.

entries.name: handleFetchResponse
entries.decision: Reject; adopted `http.request` provides explicit status/body parsing and `HttpError`.
entries.behavior: Sometimes returns a JSON Promise and otherwise throws JSON-stringified pseudo-errors.

entries.name: parseError
entries.decision: Reject; preserve adopted `HttpError` instances and causes instead.
entries.behavior: Parses stringified errors through broken legacy `isJSON`.

entries.name: handleFetch
entries.decision: Reject; adopted `http.request` composes caller cancellation and timeout without delays or automatic retries.
entries.behavior: Forces GET, delays requests, mixes caller/internal signals, clears timeout before fetch settles, and converts final rejection into a resolved parsed value.

entries.name: importFile
entries.decision: Reject; use adopted `http.request` for URLs or a separate browser `File` reader for local files.
entries.behavior: Starts an asynchronous fetch but returns before `data` can be assigned.

entries.name: checkImageURL
entries.decision: Reject misleading validation claim; future helper must be named extension/syntax check or inspect media metadata.
entries.behavior: Regex checks an HTTP(S) URL suffix only; misses query strings and says nothing about content.

entries.name: debug
entries.decision: Reject generic helper and omit a 2.0 `debug` category; diagnostics stay operation/app-specific and inert by default.
entries.behavior: Formats and conditionally writes diagnostic values to the console.
entries.evidence: Source reviewed; the portfolio copy is imported once but has no live call, while active Mindspace/COMPOSR diagnostics are app-owned coordinators/profilers.
